description: This C# source file defines extension methods for the ISiloPersistentStreamConfigurator interface in the Orleans framework, specifically for configuring different types of queue balancers used in persistent stream configuration within an Orleans silo. It includes methods to set up consistent ring, static cluster deployment, dynamic cluster deployment, and lease-based queue balancers.

classes.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfiguratorExtension
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure different queue balancers on ISiloPersistentStreamConfigurator.

methods.name: UseConsistentRingQueueBalancer
methods.description: Configures the stream provider to use the consistent ring queue balancer for partition balancing.

methods.name: UseStaticClusterConfigDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures the stream provider to use a static cluster configuration deployment balancer with optional silo maturity period.

methods.name: UseDynamicClusterConfigDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures the stream provider to use a dynamic cluster configuration deployment balancer with optional silo maturity period.

methods.name: UseLeaseBasedQueueBalancer
methods.description: Configures the stream provider to use a lease-based queue balancer with optional configuration options.
